title: One-on-One Full-Court Battle
description: Two players compete full-court one-on-one, combining transition offense, transition defense and half-court scoring in a single live format.

content.objective: Combine transition play and half-court scoring skill in one continuous, competitive full-court matchup.
content.setup: Two players start at one baseline and play live, full-court one-on-one to a target score.
instructions: The offensive player attacks the full length of the court against the defender.
A score, steal, or defensive rebound immediately flips the roles the other direction.
Play continuously to a target score, such as seven points.
Rest briefly between games and rotate to a new opponent.
coachingPoints: Transition mentally immediately on any change of possession.
Pace yourself across the full game rather than sprinting out of breath early.
Play disciplined defense even while tired from the previous possession.
commonMistakes: Jogging back on defense instead of sprinting to recover.
Forcing a tough shot out of fatigue instead of resetting the possession.
Playing carelessly in a round that feels less important.
content.safety: Keep contact controlled; call fouls to maintain a fair and safe pace.
